summary: Created comprehensive UI_ACCESS_GUIDE.md documenting all methods to access the Marketing Hub UI. The guide covers 4 access methods: Web Dev Server (fastest, working), Playwright Browser Automation (for testing/automation), Electron Desktop App (currently broken due to workspace hoisting issue), and Chromium Direct (for headless automation). Includes comparison table, troubleshooting section, feature compatibility matrix, and development workflow recommendations.
current_status: UI_ACCESS_GUIDE.md created successfully. The guide consolidates information from ELECTRON_ISSUES_RESEARCH.md, LAUNCH_ISSUE_ANALYSIS.md, and PLAYWRIGHT_SETUP.md into a single comprehensive reference for accessing the Marketing Hub UI.
